description: Kept Nick's morning unpriced and unfinished.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Refused a Christmas night and refused to turn the share into a balance.
name: George Bryan

description: Stated the thirty-five, named Monday and Thursday, and called it no balance.
name: John Heminges

description: Told him to walk the figure home and to skip the page.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Kept this week distinct from last Saturday.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Refused the coat and the toast.
name: Will Kemp

description: Entered thirty-five shillings and closed the book on a blank.
name: William Shakespeare
